sourceText:
Garnachas
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 11:56pm

Ingredients




1/2 Onion, minced
1/2 Green pepper, chopped
1 lrg Tomato, peeled, seeded and chopped
3 tablespoons Vegetable oil
12 Tortillas
2 cups Cooking oil
Frijoles Refritos (see index)
Shredded Longhorn cheese

Preparation

1 1. Saute the onion, green pepper, and tomato in the 3 tbs. oil until tender. 2 2. Cut the tortillas in quarters and brown in deep oil. 3 3. Spread each tortilla chip with the refried beans and then the tomato sauce. 4 4. Place on a cookie sheet and sprinkle the cheese over. Place in a hot oven or under the broiler until the cheese has melted. 5 WINE: BRILLANTE
